newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Rizal Comm Bank allots US$50 mln FRCD.
newsitem.headline: Rizal Comm Bank allots US$50 mln FRCD.

text.p: Rizal Commercial Banking Corp's US$50 million floating rate certificate of deposit issue has been allotted, arranger LTCB Asia said.
The facility has a final maturity of five years with put and a call options in year three.
The issue was priced at par to float at 75 basis points over the three-month London Interbank Offered Rate.
With fees, the all-in return for top-tier managers is 87 basis points.
Arranger LTCB Asia committed US$14 million.
Co-arranger and lead manager Daiwa Securities (HK) committed US$7 million. Another co-arranger, PT Bank Negara Indonesia (Persero) Singapore, committed US$6 million.
Co-lead managers with US$5 million each, are Bangkok Bank PCL Manila and WestLB Asia Pacific.

Co-manager AFC Merchant Bank committed US$3 million. Other co-managers, with US$2 million each, are Berliner Bank Aktiengesellschaft, Fuji International Finance (HK), Sanwa International Finance, Siam Commercial Bank PCL Singapore and Yamaichi International (HK).
